instagram.caption:
Your shopping cart is about to get a recommendation engine worthy of your Spotify playlists.

Five ex-Spotify employees just raised $10 million to teach retail the same algorithm that predicts your next favorite song. Their startup applies music-matching tech to products, so stores can learn your taste like a habit, not a transaction. The pitch: predict what you'll buy before you even know you want it.

For anyone selling online, this changes the game—your storefront could soon curate like a streaming service, not a catalog. No commitment to try it: they're already offering demo runs on your own site.

Think a machine can read your shopping impulses? Or is this one step too far into the cart? 🛒📦🧠
